page: Amazon Web Services m7i-flex.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The configuration includes 32 vCPUs, derived from 16 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The processor is equipped with 48 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 105 MB of L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions for accelerated mathematical and matrix operations.

The instance is provisioned with 128.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results position the m7i-flex.8xlarge as a capable performer across general-purpose workloads. It demonstrates strong performance in single-threaded gzip compression at 32.42 GB/sec, Geekbench single-core metrics at 2023.0, and static web serving throughput at 48.18 GB/sec. Multi-core operations, such as stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core, fall within the average tier. For machine learning tasks, the hardware achieves strong text generation speeds of 332.68 tokens/sec on small 135M LLM models, though performance drops to a weak 2.67 tokens/sec for large 70B models. This resource profile is well-suited for web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale serialization tasks.
